name: Alba Thermal Springs & Spa
signature: Contemporary geothermal bathing and spa treatments in a landscaped Fingal setting.
editorNote:
Alba offers bookable bathing sessions and spa treatments in Fingal. The current bathing offer includes geothermal, rain, botanical and cold-plunge pools, plus sauna and steam room. Inclusions and access differ by experience, so check the booking details before you choose an arrival time.

Standard bathing includes a locker, towel and bathrobe. Thyme is the on-site dining option, which can be booked separately. Allow a relaxed gap before any later reservation, and check the latest hours and package details directly.
whyWeGo: The landscaped pools and spa make a bathing session an easy anchor for a slower Peninsula day.
ifOnlyOneThing: Choose your bathing experience and arrival time on Alba's booking page, then keep the rest of the day light.
